root_idea.summary: A root of unsettled movement: motion marked by agitation, disturbance, or being set in motion.
root_idea.development: The lexical field extends from fearful trembling and compelled rushing to things carried or advancing, with further applications to flowing liquid, rapid walking or weeping, and a small creeping creature.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form هَرَعَ rather than the inflected passive imperfect Quran lemma يُهْرَعُ.

senses.definition: To be driven or impelled forcefully and rapidly; to be rushed onward.
senses.usage_conditions: Attested in the Quran in the passive imperfect يُهْرَعُونَ, describing people being driven or rushed onward; one occurrence presents the movement as directed toward someone.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical passive verbal use describing fearful agitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fool or person of unstable judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is explained through disturbance or instability of opinion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tree material carried from place to place by the wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the light, wind-borne material of a tree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A flowing tear or flowing blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for liquid issuing and running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come forward openly or advance in an unobstructed manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression describing spears advancing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To extend or level a spear quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional spear-related construction denoting rapid extension or presentation of the weapon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Quick in walking or quick to weep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of rapid movement or readily occurring weeping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small louse or small creeping creature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical item is reported with several variant forms.

cautions: The Quranic group is classified by QAC as Form I and is presented under هَرَعَ; its surface passive imperfect يُهْرَعُ is also discussed in the lexical evidence alongside the related form أَهْرَعَ.
